target_customer: Frontier AI labs and research institutes (datasets, evals, RL environments) and compute heavy firms needing provably correct optimized code
problem: AI generated math and code are hard to trust; Cajal uses Lean to formally verify results and optimized routines.
business_model: Sells verified proof datasets, benchmarks and RL environments to AI labs; product Tau offers verified code speedups with demo requests
product_category: Formal verification and AI for mathematics

founders.name: Pedro Nobre
founders.background_notes: Works on formal verification and AI per YC page.

founders.name: Luke Johnston
education: Research labs at Oxford, Cambridge and UCL (machine learning, neuroscience)

competitors.name: Harmonic
competitors.what: Aristotle model for mathematical reasoning with Lean 4 verified outputs
competitors.funding_then: 120M USD Series C at 1.45B valuation in Nov 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Autoformalization and proving real applied mathematics in Lean at scale is research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Verified datasets and know-how are hard to replicate, but well funded labs work on the same problem.

market_need_then: Frontier labs were buying verifiable data and RL environments, and formal verification startups drew funding in 2025 and 2026, but customer evidence for Cajal itself was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses caj.al, a Albania ccTLD domain hack, rather than cajal.com

identity.visual_style: Minimal single product page; hero image filename references Purkinje and Cajal neuroscience drawings

branding.community_and_virality: Open sourced Talos, a Lean WASM verifier, and was covered by aggregator writeups; no community evidence beyond that.

brand_strength.rationale: Name likely nods to neuroscientist Cajal but the company does not say so, and at least two other companies share the name, including a funded neuroscience startup.

outcome_analysis: Cajal is a two person company from the Winter 2026 batch with no verified funding, customers or exit yet. It operates in a hot area where Harmonic and others raised large rounds, and its early signal is the Tau product and open source Talos, so an outcome view is premature.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights shows 500K convertible note, Dealroom 125K seed, StartupHub 5M total; none are confirmed by a primary source so no round is recorded. Outcome search found only unrelated Cajal companies. One aggregator mixes in a different Cajal. Competitors are as of early 2026.
